text:
alex: quick question — for the retention-aware ingest prioritization idea: should gateways accept a retention_hint on envelope (hot/standard/cold) or compute priority server-side based on SLA/route? thinking about enrich CPU + storage cost.
leah: i'd vote for gateway hint + server-side sanity checks. gateway has the context (route, auth tier) and can give a best-effort hint. server keeps final say.
todd: gateway hints are useful but they can be gamed. we need an auth policy that maps customer -> max retention tier so gateway can't request 'hot' for everyone.
maya: +1 to todd. also we should avoid adding too many fields to envelope. maybe reuse existing billing_key + add "retention_ttl" (seconds) and "priority_hint": ["low","normal","high"]. example envelope:```{
  "billing_key": "acct:acme-123",
  "priority_hint": "normal",
  "retention_ttl": 2592000,
  "payload": {...}
}```
ryan: how does this affect cost attribution and billing? if gateway truncates or drops, we need provenance for chargeback and debugging.
alex: good point. proposal: include retention_hint + origin_decision field (gateway/service name) that is optional. server will canonicalize and emit a provenance token for the billing pipeline.
leah: provenance adds size but we only need a short token. maybe `prov:gw:us-east-1:svcA` format. ingestion can expand it for audit logs.
ingest-bot: deploy note: changed envelope schema v2.3 will reserve 2 bytes for priority flags; migration window 30d.
todd: fallback behaviour: if ingress is overloaded we should probabilistically demote 'normal' to 'cold' rather than drop. demotion rules live in shard-scheduler config.
maya: demotion complicates trace reconstruction. we need to emit demotion events as attached metadata so downstream reconstruction can weight traces.
ryan: for billing accuracy, demoted items should still be tagged with original requested tier. billing should bill on final persisted tier, but alert when demotion rate > 5% for a tenant.
alex: POC plan: (1) add priority_hint & retention_ttl to envelope, (2) add auth->max-tier mapping in gateway, (3) implement server-side canonicalizer + provenance token, (4) update batching demotion logic, (5) expose demotion metrics in console.
leah: i'll draft a short RFC and include example envelope JSON + migration notes. ping me if you want to collab.
alex: thanks — @leah and @todd can you sync tomorrow 10am? otherwise i'll post RFC link here.
